nonMember.description: No automatic 2-week / 1-day early reminders; existing behavior unchanged

memberReminders.storage: Saved on this phone in localStorage (reminderSignup, memberReminders schedule) and, on Hall Rental / Potluck email forms, included in the email to VFW7243@yahoo.com
